description.short_caption: Culture plate showing colonies from CSF sample.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a culture plate with multiple white, raised, and shiny colonies growing on the surface. The colonies are arranged in streak patterns, consistent with streak plate inoculation. The morphology suggests a fungal or bacterial organism, but further identification would require additional testing. The image is well-lit, and the colonies are clearly visible.

description.short_caption: Gram stain of CSF showing gram-positive yeast forms with budding.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Visible are clusters of gram-positive yeast forms with budding, indicative of fungal elements. The organisms appear darkly stained against a lighter background. The morphology is consistent with a fungal infection, potentially Cryptococcus species, though definitive identification requires further testing.
visible_findings: light background with darkly stained organisms
